task.instruction: Search for the latest research papers on quantum computing submitted to ArXiv within the last two days.

final_answer:
I searched arXiv via Advanced Search, filtered to Quantum Physics (quant-ph, cross-lists excluded) and to the submission-date window covering the last two days (Nov 5–7, 2026), sorted newest-first. The window returned 88 results — notably, arXiv submission metadata on this page shows the papers as submitted 5 November 2026 (the most recent batch processed); there were no entries dated Nov 6–7 yet.

Highlights from the newest submissions (arXiv:2611.08xxx block, all submitted 5 November 2026):

• **Provable circuit-level thresholds for non-abelian topological phases** — Yuanjie Ren, Margarita Davydova, Shankar Balasubramanian, Andreas Bauer (2611.08488, 37pp).
• **Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems** — Al-Sulaiti, Chen, Dastagir, Farouk, Al-Kuwari (2611.08461).
• **Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss** — Armando Angrisani, Hela Mhiri (2611.08444).
• **Quantum enhanced beam displacement estimation: sensitivity limits, optimal probes, and measurement schemes** — Novák, Colomer, Zhang, Köse, Gessner (2611.08427).
• **Disorder-blind Mpemba acceleration of quantum state preparation** — Nishanth, Sadugol, Mahmoudi, Yosifov, Iyer, Ghosh, Sun (2611.08424).
• **Recalibration-Aware Optimization of ZEFOZ Operating Points in 167Er³⁺:Y₂SiO₅ for Quantum Memories** — Shashank Srivastava (2611.08396).
• **Testing Gravitationally-Induced-Entanglement with Massive Particles and Quantum Clocks** — Tobar, Aspelmeyer, Zych (2611.08313).
• **Beyond Quantum Messages: Toward Quantum-Native Network Functioning** — Cacciapuoti, Illiano, De Risi, Caleffi (2611.08298).
• **Entropic measures of quantum information** — Rubboli, Regula, Berta, Lami, Tomamichel (2611.08254, 84-page review).
• **Certifying quantum code and circuit distances at scale** — Cheng, Guo, Pan (2611.08247).
• **Dualities in one-dimensional quantum lattice models: Lie groups, Schur-Weyl duality and symmetry breaking** — Bosgoed, Verstraete, Lootens (2611.08293).
• **Quantum Advantage with Sign-Free Proofs: An Oracle Separation between StoqMA and MA** — Hamoudi, Le Borgne, Teganahally Sridhara (2611.08180).
• **Machine learning quantum data to accelerate quantum Monte Carlo** — Jiang, Zhao, Kumar, Nigam, Rosenberg, Babbush, Baczewski, Huggins, Lee (2611.08151).
• **Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment** — Argyle, Lakhdar-Hamina, Miller, Galitski (2611.08152).
• **Semi-Analytical Geometric Synthesis of Robust Quantum Controls** — Lussi, de Santiago, Duzzioni, Silveira (2611.08107).
• **Nonuniform Time-bins for Making Raw QRNG Outputs Uniform** — Basak, Paul (2611.08096).
• **Observing mixed-state Uhlmann winding numbers in integrated photonic quantum walks** — Yu et al. (2611.07600).

Threads that stand out in this batch: quantum advantage and simulability results (boson/fermion sampling under loss; StoqMA vs MA separation), quantum error correction / code certification and non-abelian thresholds, quantum machine learning for chemistry and Monte Carlo, and quantum metrology/sensing limits. You can browse the full 88-item list here: https://arxiv.org/search/advanced?advanced=&terms-0-operator=AND&terms-0-term=&terms-0-field=all&classification-physics=y&classification-physics_archives=quant-ph&classification-include_cross_list=exclude&date-filter_by=date_range&date-from_date=2026-11-05&date-to_date=2026-11-07&date-date_type=submitted_date&abstracts=hide&size=100&order=-submitted_date

judge.rationale: The final page shows arXiv quant-ph results filtered by submitted date Nov 5–7, 2026, sorted newest-first, and the answer summarizes supported latest papers.
